# Bid the method, the laterals, and the restore.

> Price a sewer line replacement from open-cut, pipe bursting, or CIPP lining: footage, bury depth, laterals, and the surface you have to put back — not a published $125-a-foot special. See when trenchless wins and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
